capabilities: Search the vault or a single folder for text or regular expressions
List every matching line with line numbers, grouped by note
Preview each match in source or reading view without opening the note
Rank results by title, headings, properties, frequency and recency
Switch to matching notes by title, alias or folder
extras: Read-only: never writes, renames or deletes notes, makes no network requests, and saves only its own settings in the plugin data.json. Sets no hotkeys by default; the README suggests rebinding Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F and Ctrl/Cmd+O after removing the core shortcuts. Limits: Markdown notes only, skips notes over 10 MB, no find and replace, and footnotes or reference-style links to another section do not resolve in the reading preview. User guide, changelog and contributing links are external to the README.
intentEvidence: Needle brings the "Find in Files" panel from code editors to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's core search lists matching notes rather than matching lines, so you must open each note to see whether a hit is the one you want.

relations.evidence: Needle: Find in vault | Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F | Search: Search in all files
Needle: Go to note | Ctrl/Cmd+O | Quick switcher: Open quick switcher

summary: Vault-wide text search panel that lists every matching line grouped by note, with ranked results and a live preview of each match.
